purpose: Provide retrieval-ready troubleshooting actions for common telecom network conditions represented by the dataset. These SOPs are synthetic and must not be treated as vendor-specific operational procedures.
usage_rules: Retrieve SOPs based on the observed network condition and supporting metrics.
Use SQL/ML/RAG evidence before selecting a recommendation.
Do not claim that an action will definitely resolve an issue.
If evidence is insufficient, recommend investigation and escalation rather than inventing a root cause.
Recommendations should be adapted to the actual affected metrics and retrieved historical incidents.

sops.name: High Latency Investigation
diagnostic_checks: Check whether latency is elevated compared with similar historical incidents.
Check packet loss and jitter for simultaneous degradation.
Check throughput, user count, and data usage for possible load-related conditions.
Review Alarm Count and Critical Alarm Count.
recommended_actions: Investigate the affected network segment for congestion or capacity-related conditions.
Review active and recent alarms associated with the affected segment.
Compare the condition with retrieved historical incidents.
If degradation persists, escalate the affected segment for detailed network investigation.

sops.name: Packet Loss Investigation
diagnostic_checks: Compare packet loss with historical observations for similar network conditions.
Check latency and jitter for correlated degradation.
Check throughput for performance degradation.
Review Alarm Count and Critical Alarm Count.
recommended_actions: Investigate the affected network path or segment.
Review network alarms associated with the affected condition.
Check for simultaneous latency and jitter degradation.
Use historical incident matches to identify previously observed response patterns.
Escalate if packet loss remains elevated after investigation.

sops.name: Call Drop Investigation
diagnostic_checks: Check signal strength in the affected observation.
Check handover success rate.
Check connection setup success rate.
Compare the condition with similar historical incidents.
recommended_actions: Investigate radio coverage and signal conditions in the affected area.
Review handover performance for the affected network area.
Review connection setup performance.
Check related network alarms.
Escalate persistent call-drop degradation for radio or mobility investigation.

sops.name: Poor Handover Performance
diagnostic_checks: Check handover success rate against comparable historical observations.
Check call drop rate for related service degradation.
Check signal strength.
Review connection setup success rate and relevant alarms.
recommended_actions: Investigate the affected cell or mobility path.
Review neighboring-cell and handover-related network conditions.
Check for corresponding call-drop degradation.
Review recent Parameter Changes and configuration-change success.
Escalate persistent handover degradation for mobility optimization.

sops.name: Low Signal Strength Investigation
diagnostic_checks: Compare signal strength with similar historical observations.
Check call drop rate.
Check handover success rate.
Check geographic context using City, State, and Zip.
recommended_actions: Investigate radio coverage in the affected geographic area.
Review related call-drop and handover performance.
Review relevant alarms and recent network changes.
Escalate persistent coverage degradation for radio-network investigation.

sops.name: Network Congestion Investigation
sops.scenario: Possible network load or congestion condition
diagnostic_checks: Check user count and data usage.
Check throughput degradation.
Check latency and packet loss.
Compare the current condition with similar historical observations.
recommended_actions: Investigate capacity and load conditions in the affected network segment.
Review performance degradation alongside user and traffic levels.
Review network alarms.
If sustained, escalate for capacity or traffic-management investigation.

sops.name: Alarm and Fault Investigation
diagnostic_checks: Review Alarm Count and Critical Alarm Count.
Check cell availability.
Check MTTR.
Check predicted fault risk.
Compare against similar historical observations.
recommended_actions: Prioritize investigation of critical alarms.
Review affected network performance metrics.
Use historical incident matches to identify similar conditions.
Review repair duration and previous operational response.
Escalate when critical alarms and service degradation occur together.

sops.name: Configuration Change Investigation
sops.scenario: Network degradation associated with configuration activity
diagnostic_checks: Review the number of parameter changes.
Check configuration-change success rate.
Check alarms after configuration activity.
Compare with historical observations.
recommended_actions: Review recent configuration changes affecting the network condition.
Identify unsuccessful configuration changes for investigation.
Review alarms and service metrics associated with the change.
Validate the configuration before making further changes.
Escalate if degradation persists.

sops.name: Network Availability and Recovery Investigation
sops.scenario: Low cell availability or prolonged repair condition
diagnostic_checks: Check cell availability.
Check MTTR.
Review alarm and critical-alarm activity.
Compare with similar historical incidents.
recommended_actions: Prioritize investigation of the affected cell or network segment.
Review critical alarms and associated service metrics.
Use historical incidents to identify similar recovery patterns.
Review repair duration and operational response.
Escalate prolonged or recurring availability degradation.

sops.name: Security and Authentication Investigation
sops.scenario: Elevated security incidents or authentication failures
diagnostic_checks: Review security incident count.
Review authentication failure count.
Compare the condition with historical observations.
Check whether network performance degradation is occurring simultaneously.
recommended_actions: Investigate the affected authentication or security-related component.
Review relevant security events and operational logs.
Check for simultaneous network-service degradation.
Escalate persistent or unusual security activity to the appropriate security operations process.

sops.name: Multi-Metric Network Degradation Investigation
sops.scenario: Multiple network performance indicators degraded simultaneously
diagnostic_checks: Identify which metrics are outside the normal historical pattern.
Check whether alarms coincide with the degradation.
Retrieve similar historical incidents.
Check the predicted fault risk.
Avoid selecting a definitive root cause without supporting evidence.
recommended_actions: Prioritize the metrics showing the strongest degradation.
Review corresponding alarms and operational changes.
Compare with the most similar historical incidents.
Investigate the affected network segment using the combined evidence.
Escalate when multiple critical indicators remain degraded.
